priority_1.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 minutes Zone 2 running, finishing with 3x 30-second progressive strides. Main Set: 5x 800 meters at target 5km pace (Zone 5, RPE 9/10, target HR 175-185 bpm). Rest: 2 minutes and 30 seconds of walking/light jogging between intervals. Cool-down: 10 minutes Zone 1/2 jogging.

priority_2.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 minutes progressive ramp up to 180W, including 3x 30-second high-cadence spins. Main Set: 3x 10 minutes at 227W to 240W (Sweet Spot, target cadences 90-95 RPM). Rest: 4 minutes of easy spinning recovery at 120W between sets. Cool-down: 10 minutes easy spinning.
priority_2.reason: Highly efficient at driving CTL upward toward your target of 60. It leverages your deep cycling background to accumulate high training load with manageable recovery costs.

priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 minutes dynamic mobility. Main Lift 1: Barbell Back Squats - 4 sets of 5 reps at 80% 1RM (~85kg). Main Lift 2: Barbell Deadlift - 3 sets of 5 reps at 80% 1RM (~100kg). Accessory 1: Barbell Overhead Press - 3 sets of 8 reps. Accessory 2: Kettlebell Swings (20kg) - 3 sets of 15 reps. Core: 3 sets of 45-second heavy sandbag (70kg) holds or carries.
priority_3.reason: Builds the neural drive and muscular torque required for high cycling wattages and running efficiency. This is a non-cardio alternative if you prefer to build strength today.
